name: The Orrery
summary: Nested worlds turning inside one another like a cosmic clockwork.
description: A world from ARCHIVE: Worlds Within Worlds (chapter 3). It is drawn by the film's raymarching shader (worlds-within-worlds/src/worlds/20_orrery.glsl). Opens the film studio at this chapter; a standalone interactive version is a planned adaptation (see docs/RECOMMENDATIONS.md).

status.notes: Viewable in the film studio; interactive adaptation planned.
